Strong experience with React and TypeScript . Experience building and consuming web APIs. Working experience with AWS Lambda and scheduled or batch processing. Familiarity with deploying or operating applications using AWS App Runner and AWS Amplify , or closely related AWS services. Experience integrating third-party data sources and handling data validation and transformation. Experience with Mapbox or another web mapping platform. Clear communication and the ability to work with an existing application and codebase. jobs.title: Performance Engineer- Software Engineer-III
jobs.description: We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our performance engineering team. This role provides an opportunity to lead projects and contribute to high-impact software solutions that are used by enterprises and users worldwide. As a performance Engineer, you will be responsible for designing performance strategies, evaluating and optimizing complex software systems, ensuring their reliability and maintainability, and mentoring junior engineers.. You will work in a collaborative environment, contributing to the technical foundation behind our flagship products and services. Responsibilities: Performance Engineering: Identify performance requirements and risks early in the development lifecycle. Execute load and stress tests, interpret results, analyze performance bottlenecks, and work with the team to improve response times, throughput, and resource utilization. Monitoring and Observability: Build and use monitoring, logging, tracing, and alerting to understand service behavior. Define and review service health indicators, use telemetry to detect performance regressions, and make systems easier to diagnose in production. Project Management: Be able to manage performance execution and delivery of features and projects, negotiating project priorities and deadlines, ensuring successful and timely completion, with quality. Code and Runtime Optimization: Analyze application and system behavior to find inefficient code paths or resource usage. Recommend and implement optimizations, then validate their impact through measurement and testing. Performance Troubleshooting: Investigate complex performance issues using profiling and diagnostic tools, including heap and thread dump analysis. Identify root causes and drive fixes and preventive measures. Architectural Design: Participate in or lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders, and contribute to the architectural design of new features and systems. Consider scalability, reliability, maintainability, observability, and performance throughout the design process. Mentorship: Provide technical mentorship and guidance to junior engineers, fostering a culture of learning and growth. Code Review: Review code developed by other engineers, provide constructive feedback, and maintain a high bar for technical excellence. Promote coding guidelines, elegant and efficient implementations, maintainability, observability, and unit testing. Testing: Develop and maintain performance test scripts and automation using tools such as LoadRunner, NeoLoad, JMeter, and JavaScript-based frameworks. Debugging and Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve technical issues to ensure high-quality service operations. Service Health and Quality: Maintain service health and quality, proactively identifying and resolving issues. Use service health indicators and telemetry to recommend improvements to reliability and performance. Lead thorough root cause analyses and implement measures to prevent recurrence. Documentation: Document new features, enhancements, fixes, and relevant performance findings. Contribute to technical documentation and training materials. Innovation: Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends, advocating for their adoption where appropriate to improve innovation and productivity within the team (e.g., Copilot). Minimum Qualifications: Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 5+ years of experience either in software development or performance engineering, preferably in a product-based or SaaS organization. Deep expertise in one or more programming languages such as C, C++, C#, .NET, Python, Java, or JavaScript. Hands-On experience with software development practices and in workload modeling, performance test planning, scripting, test execution, monitoring, and results analysis. Proficiency with performance testing and APM Tools such as LoadRunner, NeoLoad, JMeter, k6, Grafana, Dynatrace. Use APM and diagnostic tools such as Grafana, Datadog, dynatrace, Fiddler, browser developer tools, and platform monitoring solutions to identify bottlenecks and performance risks. Proven track record of delivering complex software projects on time and within budget. Proficiency with version control systems like GitHub and bug/work tracking systems like JIRA. Understanding of cloud technologies and DevOps principles. Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment. jobs.title: Agentic AI Engineer
jobs.description: Job Summary As an Agentic AI Engineer at Hudson Data, you will design, build, and ship LLM-powered agents that do real work: researching cases, analysing data, calling tools and APIs, and automating multi-step workflows for our products and for lenders and fintech partners. You will own agents end to end, from prompt and tool design through orchestration, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring in production. You will work closely with our data science, data engineering, and product teams, and help set how Hudson Data builds with AI. This is a full-time, onsite role in Gurugram, India. Responsibilities Design and build LLM-based agents and multi-agent workflows that plan, use tools, call APIs and databases, and complete multi-step tasks reliably. Build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines over structured and unstructured data, including chunking, embeddings, vector search, and re-ranking. Design clear tool interfaces (function calling, MCP servers) that connect agents to internal systems, data warehouses, and third-party services. Build evaluation harnesses: test sets, automated and LLM-as-judge evals, regression tests, and red-teaming, so agent quality is measured, not guessed. Take agents to production with solid engineering: APIs, background jobs, retries, cost and latency controls, logging, tracing, and monitoring. Put guardrails in place: permissions, human-in-the-loop review, prompt-injection defences, PII handling, and audit trails suitable for financial-services clients. Choose the right model for each job across providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, open-weight models), balancing quality, cost, and latency. Work with data scientists to combine agents with predictive models, for example agents that investigate fraud alerts or explain credit decisions. Keep up with a fast-moving field and bring the useful ideas into our stack. jobs.title: Ai Ml Engineer
jobs.description: Experience : 5+ Years Job Summary Job Title: Data Scientist (AI/ML) Data Engineering & MLOps Role Summary We are seeking a hands-on Data Scientist who can operate across data engineering and machine learning to deliver production-ready analytics/AI solutions. This role includes building data pipelines and curated datasets, developing and evaluating ML models, and supporting model operationalization with MLOps practices across the ML lifecycle (from data discovery through deployment and monitoring). Key Responsibilities Partner with business and technical stakeholders to translate problems into data-driven and ML solutions , communicating insights and model outcomes clearly Perform exploratory data analysis , feature engineering, and build predictive/advanced analytics models using Python-based DS libraries. Design, build, and maintain data pipelines and datasets to support analytics and model training (batch/near-real-time as needed). Apply MLOps discipline across the ML lifecycle: data validation, packaging, deployment support, and performance monitoring concepts. Collaborate in Agile delivery (sprint goals, user stories, iteration based on feedback). Required Skills & Experience Strong hands-on Python for data analysis and ML model development. Experience with data engineering fundamentals : data integration, data processing, and pipeline/orchestration concepts. Solid grounding in ML lifecycle / MLOps concepts (validation, versioning, deployment, monitoring). Ability to assess data sources for quality, relevance, and usability; translate business rules into analytics logic. Strong communication skillsable to bridge business stakeholders and technical teams. Preferred / Nice to Have Cloud exposure (AWS/Azure) and understanding of operationalizing ML solutions (CI/CD, monitoring patterns). Experience with modern AI/GenAI patterns (e.g., RAG/LLMs/knowledge graphs) if project requires it. Experience building reliable production-grade AI pipelines and data quality monitoring. Key Responsibilities 1. Design And Implement Advanced Machine Learning Algorithms Using Tensorflow And Pytorch To Extract Insights From Large Datasets, Delivering Customized Analytical Reports Tailored To The Needs Of Colleagues, Clients, And Stakeholders. 2. Leverage Python And Sql To Develop And Optimize Data Models That Address Specific Organizational Challenges, Ensuring Effective Integration And Management Of Data. 3. Analyze And Mine Large Datasets To Identify Trends And Patterns, Utilizing Advanced Analytics Techniques To Interpret Findings And Provide Actionable Recommendations Based On Experimental Results. 4. Collaborate With Cross-Functional Teams To Identify Opportunities For Utilizing Data Insights To Formulate Strategic Business Solutions That Enhance Operational Efficiency And Product Offerings. 5. Create Comprehensive Visualizations And Reports Using Data Visualization Tools To Communicate Complex Analysis And Results Clearly, Enabling Informed Decision-Making For Customers And Stakeholders. Skill Requirements 1. - Strong Knowledge Of Machine Learning Principles And Algorithms Using Tensorflow And Pytorch. 2. - Proficient In Programming Languages Such As Python For Data Analysis And Model Development. 3. - Solid Understanding Of Sql For Data Manipulation And Querying Large Databases. 4. - In-Depth Experience With Data Analytics Techniques And Tools For Interpreting Complex Datasets. 5. - Excellent Collaboration And Communication Skills To Work With Diverse Teams And Stakeholders. Must Have Skills Python Machine Learning and Statistical modeling Pytorch Tensorflow 5-10 Yrs Artificial Intelligence, Pytorch, Python, Ml, Tensorflow, Machine, Machine learning

jobs.title: Intern - Software Development
jobs.description: About GoKwik GoKwik is building the growth operating system for D2C and eCommerce brands, helping businesses optimise checkout, reduce RTO, enable payments, drive retention, and strengthen post-purchase engagement. With 15,000+ merchants globally and a growing presence across India, the UK, Europe, and the US, GoKwik is building AI-powered infrastructure that enables brands to grow faster and operate better. Why This Role Matters We are an engineering-led technology company building and operating large-scale commerce infrastructure. Our multi-tenant platform serves multiple independent businesses, managing their catalogues, orders, inventory, pricing and customer data while handling millions of API calls every week. We are looking for a Software Development Intern who wants to work on real production systems, build scalable applications and solve engineering challenges that directly impact businesses. You will be part of an engineering team, taking ownership of well-defined tasks from development to release, with mentorship from experienced engineers. We follow an AI-first engineering approach, and you will be encouraged to use AI coding tools across development, testing and debugging while maintaining complete ownership and understanding of everything you build. What Youll Own Work on live services and take engineering tasks end to end, from understanding requirements and planning to development, testing, code reviews and release. Build and extend REST APIs using Node.js and TypeScript, with appropriate input validation, error handling and pagination. Develop and improve frontend components in React and TypeScript, including tables, forms and admin console interfaces. Write SQL queries, work with relational databases and understand query performance and indexing. Develop unit and integration tests and contribute to improving application reliability. Debug production issues using logs, monitoring tools and systematic problem-solving. Use AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or similar tools for coding, testing, debugging and documentation. Contribute to LLM-powered features and internal tools, including prompt engineering and structured outputs. Participate in code reviews, incorporate feedback and follow engineering best practices. Who You Are Pursuing or recently completed a B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Strong fundamentals in Data Structures, Algorithms, problem-solving and debugging. Hands-on programming experience in JavaScript/TypeScript (preferred) or another mainstream programming language. At least one end-to-end project, preferably involving a backend API or web application, that you can explain in depth. Basic understanding of SQL, including joins, filtering, aggregations and database indexes. Understanding of web fundamentals, including HTTP, REST APIs, status codes and client-server architecture. Regular experience using AI coding tools, with the ability to evaluate and validate AI-generated code. Familiarity with Git, pull requests and basic code review workflows. Strong communication skills, curiosity and a willingness to learn. Why GoKwik At GoKwik, you will work on real-world engineering challenges and production systems rather than isolated projects. You will gain hands-on experience building scalable technology, working with modern engineering stacks and using AI tools as part of your development workflow, while learning directly from experienced engineers. jobs.description: About Enveu Enveu is a SaaS platform empowering leading OTT platforms, broadcasters, and publishers to deliver video experiences across Web, Mobile, and Smart TVs. We are looking for an enthusiastic Full-Stack Software Engineering Intern with knowledge of Java, Spring Boot, Angular, and MySQL to work on real-world projects. Role Overview This is a 6-month, on-site internship for candidates interested in gaining practical experience in full-stack software development. The ideal candidate should have a strong foundation in Java, Spring Boot, Angular, and database management, along with hands-on experience through academic or personal projects. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain RESTful APIs using Java and Spring Boot. Assist in backend development, including business logic, services, controllers, and API integrations. Design and manage database entities, queries, and schema changes using MySQL. Develop responsive and user-friendly web interfaces using Angular, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS. Work on admin dashboards, Content Management Systems (CMS), and public-facing web applications. Integrate third-party APIs and backend services. Write and execute unit and integration tests to ensure application quality. Debug and troubleshoot application issues using logs, browser developer tools, and Postman. Collaborate with the development team using Git, GitHub, pull requests, and code reviews. Understand existing codebases and contribute to maintaining and improving application functionality. Maintain technical documentation for developed features and updates. Requirements B.Tech / B.E. / MCA / B.Sc. in CS, IT, or related fields (2025-2026 graduates or final-year students). Strong foundation in Core Java, OOP, Collections, and Exception Handling. Basic knowledge of Spring Boot, REST APIs, JPA, and Hibernate. Familiarity with Angular, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap. Understanding of MySQL, SQL queries, and database design. Knowledge of API testing using Postman or Swagger. Familiarity with Git, GitHub, unit testing, and debugging. At least one relevant academic or personal project with a GitHub profile or live demo. Preferred Skills Knowledge of Spring Security, JWT, MongoDB, and RxJS. Familiarity with Maven, Gradle, Docker, and Docker Compose. Exposure to Redis, Elasticsearch, Kafka, RabbitMQ, or ActiveMQ. Basic understanding of HLS and video streaming technologies. Experience with third-party API integrations and payment gateways. Knowledge of JUnit, Mockito, CI/CD, and Linux. Internship PPO Opportunity Work on real-world projects with guidance from experienced developers. Performance-based evaluation at the end of the 6-month internship. Eligible candidates will be considered for a PPO. Internship extension may be considered based on performance and potential. Internship Completion Letter upon successful completion.
